name: Operating Systems
topics: OS Types, System Calls and Structure
Explain the different types of operating systems with examples; differentiate hard and soft real-time OS.
Define system calls and their types; is multitasking an extension of multiprogramming?
Processes, PCB, States and Context Switching
Explain the process life cycle and process states with a diagram, and the contents of a PCB.
When does a context switch occur and what does the OS do? Explain long-, medium- and short-term schedulers.
Threads
How is a thread different from a process? Compare single-threaded and multithreaded processes with a diagram.
Contrast user-level and kernel-level threads; why is a blocking system call a problem for user-level threads?
CPU Scheduling: FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Priority, Round Robin
For the given processes, draw Gantt charts and calculate the average waiting and turnaround times under SJF, SRTF, round robin (q = 3) and priority scheduling.
Explain preemption in CPU scheduling and how it changes the average waiting time for the given process set.
Process Synchronization, Semaphores and Classical Problems
Define the critical section and its three requirements; when does a race condition arise?
Explain semaphores (wait and signal), their types, and any two classical synchronization problems with code.
Deadlocks and Banker's Algorithm
Define deadlock and its four necessary conditions, and the methods of prevention, avoidance and detection.
Using the Banker's algorithm on the given snapshot, find the Need matrix, check for a safe state and whether the given request can be granted.
Memory Management: Allocation, Paging, Segmentation
Explain contiguous allocation and fragmentation; allocate the given processes using first fit, best fit, worst fit and next fit.
For the given logical/physical address spaces and page size, compute address bits, pages, frames and page table size; explain segmentation with paging.
Virtual Memory and Page Replacement
For the given reference string and number of frames, find the page faults under FIFO, LRU and optimal page replacement.
Define page fault and demand paging; explain the role of the valid/invalid bit.
Disk Scheduling and Disk Structure
For the given request queue and head position, calculate total head movement using FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, LOOK, C-SCAN and C-LOOK.
Explain rotational latency, seek time, disk structure and how RAID improves reliability and performance.
File Systems, Directories and Free-Space Management
Describe file access methods and the allocation schemes for secondary storage.
What is a directory and how is it implemented? Explain free-space and swap-space management.
I/O and Device Management
Describe the features of device management and differentiate dedicated, shared and virtual devices.
